text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is Valentine's Day, and the students have been excitedly exchanging gifts since morning.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy! Happy Valentine's Day, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And ya can't have Valentine's Day without chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So I bought a chocolate cake to thank ya for all your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Honest, I really did buy it. But…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The thing is… that cake kinda accidentally ended up in my stomach!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But it was downright delectable! I really want ya to try it too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So let's go buy another one together! I might eat the whole thing again if I go by myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At Taiki Shuttle's urging, we go into town to buy a cake together. However…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Whaddya mean they're all sold out?!

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text: I'm terribly sorry. That cake was very popular…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What're we gonna do now? That was supposed to be your present…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unable to buy a replacement cake, Taiki grows disheartened.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can see by her expression just how much she wants to make me happy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry… I'm the only one who got to eat the cake…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But I know the rules—ya gotta give chocolate here in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Just the thought ain't enough!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okay—let's look for a different gift! You're definitely gettin' some kinda thank-you chocolate today!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ah, how 'bout this one? You eat it with rice, just like curry!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Or what about this one? You mix it with rice to make chocolate fried rice! Looks fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I spend the rest of Valentine's Day with a Taiki Shuttle determined to show her gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No! That ain't enough to put my mind at ease!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I got it! I'll make ya the chocolate cake myself! I still remember how it tasted!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I can see you're worried, but everything'll be just hunky-dory! I'm a barbeque master, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I head back to the academy, wondering what barbecues have to do with baking cakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a brief wait in my office…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the holdup! Here's your chocolate cake!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sure, it came out a little black, but it's shaped just like the cake from before. And I'm confident about the taste!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ya know, I'm kinda glad they were sold out.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You're always workin' so hard to help me.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It's only fair I work hard too to show my appreciation! Tit for tat!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Aww, you're welcome! Now, go ahead and dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle's thank-you gift ends up having a little bitterness to it.
